events.content:
The reading list is a small Next.js app. Books live in `data/books.json`, so they stay put after a restart.

- `/` shows currently reading and finished books.
- `/add` is the form for title, author, and notes.
- `/books/[id]` shows one book and can mark it finished. That URL is the shareable link.

part.text:
The reading list is a small Next.js app. Books live in `data/books.json`, so they stay put after a restart.

- `/` shows currently reading and finished books.
- `/add` is the form for title, author, and notes.
- `/books/[id]` shows one book and can mark it finished. That URL is the shareable link.
